{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id rows: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for sample_seq duplicates per patient_id
duplicates_per_patient = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique()
duplicate_patients = duplicates_per_patient[duplicates_per_patient > 1]
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {len(duplicate_patients)}")
print(f"List of patients with multiple sample_seq: {duplicate_patients.index.tolist()}")"}
